items.title: Consensus reached on who will be Iran's next leader, local media reports — as it happened
items.description: A majority consensus on who will be the successor to Ayatollah Ali Khamenei has been reached, according to members of the Assembly of Experts. Take a look back at how the day's events unfolded in our live blog.

items.title: Australia and Canada share similar values. Remind us what they are again
items.description: When Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney visited Australia last week, he had a message about Australia's and Canada's shared values. He said they were worth defending and could be used to build a more prosperous future.

items.title: Hemmed in by wars, here's how some airlines are still flying from Australia to Europe
items.description: Travel routes between Australia, Asia and Europe are narrowing. Here is how airlines are still flying the Kangaroo Route despite wars in the Middle East and Ukraine.

items.title: Man dies from stab wound to the chest after argument in Sydney house
items.description: Three men were at a home on Spring Street in Concord when emergency services were called following reports of a concern for welfare.

items.title: Three charged with murdering 'quiet hero' at Melbourne railway station
items.description: Two teenagers and a man have been charged after 22-year-old Aidan Becker died from stab wounds in Mernda on Friday night. Police are waiting to interview a fourth person about the death.

items.title: Quick hits: Catley floored and Carpenter rages as Korea frustrates Matildas
items.description: Steph Catley gets floored and Ellie Carpenter rages as Alanna Kennedy continues her hot streak. Here are the quick hits from the Matildas' 3-3 draw against Korea.

items.title: Collingwood claims spiteful MCG thriller against St Kilda
items.description: St Kilda's star recruits aren't enough to overcome Collingwood in a thriller at the MCG to cap off Opening Round.

items.title: Bennett pleads with fans to stay off the field after Johnston's record try
items.description: The Rabbitohs take down the Dolphins in a 70-point clash at Lang Park, with South Sydney's Alex Johnston scoring his 211th career try to move within one of Ken Irvine's record.

items.title: Nationals select former military commander Brad Robertson to contest Farrer
items.description: The National Party's candidate for the Farrer by-election, Brad Robertson, says the people of Farrer have been "waiting" for the Nationals to come back.

items.title: Notorious UK child killer Ian Huntley dies after prison attack
items.description: Ian Huntley had been on life support after being hit over the head with a metal bar at Frankland prison in north-east England.

items.title: Quick hits: Aussie hearts sink, Russell correctly predicts the future
items.description: Australia's collective hearts sank as Piastri went into the wall, while race winner George Russell pulled off a prediction that Nostradamus would have been proud of. These are the key moments from qualifying at Albert Park.

items.title: The K-pop concert that sparked an online war across Asia
items.description: Criticism of Korean fans bringing professional cameras into a Korean boy band concert in Malaysia, against local rules, spiralled into an online war from Vietnam to Indonesia.

items.title: Are couples happier sleeping separately?
items.description: Despite many people like Hannah finding a "sleep divorce" improves their sleep — and their relationship — a "pervasive stigma" about not sharing a bed persists.

items.title: Healy bids farewell as Australia seals crushing Test win over India
items.description: Alyssa Healy signs off her illustrious career in style as Australia wipes away India to claim an easy win in Perth.

items.title: Could Western Sydney get its own film studio?
items.description: The NSW government has earmarked three areas in Western Sydney as possible locations for the state's second film studio.

items.title: Everything you need to know about the NT's flood emergency
items.description: Wondering if schools in the Top End will be open tomorrow? Not sure what the situation is with flood evacuation centres? Looking for the latest information on natural disaster relief payments? We've answered all your NT flood-related questions here.

items.title: After 4 years, regional gallery reopens with blockbuster exhibition
items.description: Newcastle Art Gallery celebrates its $48 million expansion with a landmark show drawn from its permanent collection, which features more than 7,000 works valued at $145 million.

items.title: Fishing trip 'oopsie' as boat carrying premier ventures into sanctuary
items.description: An election campaign boat trip involving the SA premier has faced criticism after the state's peak recreational fishing body — which says it organised the trip — admitted it breached marine regulations by towing lures in a sanctuary zone.

items.title: Rock fishermen drown amid 'very choppy' conditions on NSW Central Coast
items.description: Emergency services find the bodies of two Sydney men after being called to Little Beach, at Bouddi National Park.

items.title: SA Premier says email blunder was 'completely unacceptable'
items.description: Peter Malinauskas says his government made an "unacceptable" error in releasing an email it claimed was from a terminal cancer patient who later died, but that turned out to be from a different man with the same name.

items.title: Bringing old Aussie homes into an energy efficient future
items.description: Owners of older homes are being urged to have their energy efficiency assessed, with experts saying improvements will not only make them more comfortable, but help them save money as well.

items.title: 'You had to think on your feet': How Ranger Stacey became loved by Australian kids
items.description: Nineties kids didn't dawdle on the way home from school in the afternoon. This was the age of appointment television, and that appointment was with Ranger Stacey on Totally Wild.

items.title: SA government attributes email to wrong man after death, traumatising family
items.description: A grieving woman "feels sick" after the government releases an email it claims was written by her deceased partner praising his hospital care, after she said ambulance ramping had denied him dignity in his final hours.

items.title: Promises ramped down in SA election as ambulance crisis proves hard to solve
items.description: With just two weeks to go until the state election, Labor has steered away from ambitious promises after difficulty meeting its pledge to fix the ambulance ramping crisis last election — one of the few points where the opposition's barbs are piercing.

items.title: Fire crews attend second RSL fire in Melbourne in three days
items.description: An RSL in Glen Waverley has been significantly damaged by fire in the second club blaze this week.
